notes.content: A one-page advertisement for Coca-Cola created by Burrell Communications Group (art direction by Lowell Thompson, photography by Don Getsug) published in Ebony Magazine. The advertisement features actor Raphael "Roy" McIver as a shopkeeper. McIver stands in the doorway of a store, holding a broom and enjoying a Coca-Cola with two young boys. McIver wears an apron and the boys wear red and white baseball caps. All three are holding a bottle of Coke and smiling. The boy on the left side of the man is holding a baseball bat while the boy on the right is wearing a baseball glove. Printed at the bottom right corner is "Coke / adds life... / ...when old friends drop by." The reverse side has an advertisement for Virginia Slims.
notes.label: Description
